semantic.criterion: The semantic round treats workspace mapping, legacy handoff map, and exact workspace_ref as one concept family when checking consumers.
Exact symbol reviewed_content_sha256 is searched unchanged and is not translated or paraphrased for exact lookup.
The Phase 2 review independently concludes code_subtraction and docs_ssot_subtraction applicability, scope, and result instead of deriving one from the other.
The review checks affected deprecated assets and explains production, test, generated/managed, and documentation growth without using a fixed net-line threshold.
The review treats unsupported compatibility or redundant state as a current finding rather than future cleanup when no concrete support contract exists.

The review rejects fields, persistence, retries, locks, fallbacks, or formal-idempotency mechanisms without a named direct consumer, while preserving the existing normal stale, mismatch, permission, and side-effect contracts.
The review applies the 3000-line trigger to touched non-generated code files and requires mechanical splitting or small decoupling, without importing untouched historical large files into scope.
